compare-and-z.alt: Top: parallel boxplots of delivery times in minutes for two restaurants, 15 orders each. Restaurant A has median 32 and a narrow box from 28 to 36. Restaurant B has a lower median, 27, a wider box from 23 to 37, a long right whisker and one high outlier at 60. Bottom: a z-score number line from minus 3 to plus 3 with the mean at 0; a value with z = 1.5 sits 1.5 standard deviations above the mean.
